meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 GitHub 上的代码改动变成一段讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚合并一批改动,想快速录一段讲解给团队或用户看。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub pull request into a video that explains the code change
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just merged changes and want a quick explainer video for your team or users.

howto.what: 给它一个 GitHub PR 链接、owner/repo#N 或仓库里的“this PR”,它会读取 diff 与提交,写出分镜和旁白脚本,逐帧生成画面,最后导出讲解这次代码改动的视频(renders/video.mp4)。
howto.when: 当你要把一次 GitHub PR(PR 链接、owner/repo#N,或已检出仓库里的“this PR”)做成讲解视频时接管;它只处理代码改动,不是产品宣传片或无 PR 的话题解说。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成讲解视频:acme/sdk#1842
say.note: 读取 diff 和提交后产出分镜与成片

say.text: 用 this PR 做一支修复改动讲解视频
say.note: 读取当前仓库里的这次改动

say.text: 旁白用男声,把 acme/sdk#1842 做成视频
say.note: 传入 --voice 指定旁白音色

howto.what_en: Give it a GitHub PR (a URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo): it reads the diff, commits and files, writes a storyboard and script, builds frames, and exports a code-change explainer video to renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you hand it a GitHub PR — a PR link, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo. It only handles code changes, not product promos or no-PR topic explainers.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into an explainer video: acme/sdk#1842
say_en.note: Reads the diff, then builds storyboard and video

say_en.text: Make a fix-explainer video from this PR
say_en.note: Reads the change in the current repo

say_en.text: Use a male voice and turn acme/sdk#1842 into a video
say_en.note: Passes --voice to pick the narration voice
